newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mori Denki corrects terms of convertible bond.
newsitem.headline: Mori Denki corrects terms of convertible bond.

text.p: Mori Denki Manufacturing Co Ltd on Friday corrected the terms of a convertible bond it is planning to issue.
In a statement it said that the maturity of the bond was January 9, 2001, not January 6, 2001, as announced earlier.
It also said that the conversion period was from February 1, 1997, to December 27, 2000, not February 1, 1997, to December 27, 2001.
